an4.180:1.1: Ekaṃ samayaṃ Bhagavā Bhoganagare viharati Ānanda-cetiye.
an4.180:1.4: Bhadante ti te bhikkhū Bhagavato paccassosuṃ.
an4.180:1.8: Evaṃ bhante ti kho te bhikkhū Bhagavato paccassosuṃ.
an4.180:2.3: sammukhā me taṃ āvuso Bhagavato sutaṃ sammukhā paṭiggahītaṃ,
an4.180:2.4: ayaṃ dhammo ayaṃ vinayo idaṃ satthu-sāsanaṇ ti,
an4.180:2.5: tassa bhikkhave bhikkhuno bhāsitaṃ n' eva abhinanditabbaṃ na paṭikkositabbam,
an4.180:2.6: anabhinanditvā appaṭikkositvā tāni padavyañjanāni sādhukaṃ uggahetvā sutte otāretabbāni vinaye sandassetabbāni:
an4.180:2.7: tāni ce sutte otāriyamānāni vinaye sandassiyamānāni na c' eva sutte otaranti na vinaye sandissanti niṭṭhaṃ ettha gantabbaṃ--addhā
an4.180:2.8: idam na c' eva tassa Bhagavato vacanaṃ arahato sammāsambuddhassa,
an4.180:3.1: Idha pana bhikkhave bhikkhu evaṃ vadeyya:
an4.180:3.2: sammukhā me taṃ āvuso Bhagavato sutaṃ . . .
an4.180:3.4: tassa bhikkhave bhikkhuno n' eva abhinanditabbaṃ na
an4.180:3.6: tāni ce sutte otāriyamānānivinaye sandassiyamānāni sutte c' eva otaranti vinaye ca sandissanti niṭṭhaṃ ettha gantabbaṃ--addhā
an4.180:3.7: idaṃ tassa Bhagavato vacanaṃ arahato sammāsambuddhassa,
an4.180:4.1: Idha pana bhikkhave bhikkhu evaṃ vadeyya:
an4.180:4.2: amukasmiṃ nāma āvāse saṅgho viharati sa-thero sa-pāmokkho
an4.180:4.3: tassa me saṅghassa sammukhā sutaṃ sammukhā paṭiggahītaṃ,
an4.180:4.4: ayaṃ dhammo ayaṃ vinayo idaṃ satthusāsanan ti,
an4.180:4.5: tassa bhikkhave bhikkhuno bhāsitaṃ n' eva abhinanditabbaṃ na paṭikkositabbaṃ,
an4.180:4.6: anabhinanditvā appaṭikkositvā tāni padavyañjanāni sādhukaṃ uggahetvā sutte otāretabbāni vinaye sandassetabbāni:
an4.180:4.7: tani ce sutte otāriyamānāni vinaye sandassiyamānāni na c' eva sutte otaranti na vinaye sandissanti niṭṭhaṃ ettha gantabbaṃ--addhā
an4.180:4.8: idaṃ na c' eva tassa Bhagavato vacanaṃ arahato sammāsambuddhassa,
an4.180:5.2: amukasmiṃ nāma āvāse saṅgho viharati sathero sapāmokkho
an4.180:5.3: tassa me saṅghassa sammukhā sutaṃ sammukhā paṭiggahītaṃ,
an4.180:5.4: ayaṃ dhammo ayaṃ vinayo idaṃ satthusāsan ti,
an4.180:5.5: tassa bhikkhave bhikkhuno bhāsitaṃ n' eva abhinanditabbaṃ na paṭikkositabbaṃ,
an4.180:5.6: anabhinanditvā appaṭikkositvā tāni padavyañjanāni sādhukaṃ uggahetvā sutte otāretabbāni vinaye sandassetabbāni:
an4.180:5.7: tāni ce sutte otāriyamānāni vinaye sandassiyamānāni sutte c' eva otaranti vinaye ca sandissanti niṭṭham ettha gantabbaṃ--addhā
an4.180:5.8: idaṃ tassa Bhagavato vacanaṃ arahato sammāsambuddhassa,
an4.180:6.1: Idha pana bhikkhave bhikkhu evaṃ vadeyya:
an4.180:6.2: amukasmiṃ nāma āvāse sambahulā therā bhikkhū viharanti bahussutā āgatāgamā dhammadharā vinayadharā mātikādharā,
an4.180:6.3: tesaṃ me therānaṃ sammukhā sutaṃ sammukhā paṭiggahītaṃ,
an4.180:6.4: ayaṃ dhammo ayaṃ vinayo idaṃ satthusāsanan ti,
an4.180:6.5: tassa bhikkhave bhikkhuno bhāsitaṃ n' eva abhinanditabbaṃ na paṭikkositabbaṃ,
an4.180:6.6: anabhinanditvā appaṭikkositvā tāni padavyañjanāni sādhukaṃ uggahetvā sutte otāretabbāni vinaye sandassetabbāni:
an4.180:6.7: tāni ce sutte otāriyamānāni vinaye sandassiyamānāni na c' eva sutte otaranti na vinaye sandissanti niṭṭhaṃ ettha gantabbam--addhā
an4.180:6.8: idaṃ na c' eva tassa Bhagavato vacanaṃ . . .
an4.180:7.1: Idha pana bhikkhave bhikkhu evaṃ vadeyya:
an4.180:7.7: tāni ce sutte otāriyamānāni vinaye sandassiyamānāni sutte c' eva otaranti vinaye ca sandissanti niṭṭhaṃ ettha gantabbaṃ--
an4.180:8.1: Idha pana bhikkhave bhikkhu evaṃ vadeyya:
an4.180:8.2: amukasmiṃ nāma āvāse eko thero bhikkhu viharati bahussuto āgatāgamo dhammadharo vinayadharo mātikādharo,
an4.180:8.3: tassa me therassa sammukhā sutam sammukhā paṭiggahītaṃ,
an4.180:8.4: ayaṃ dhammo ayaṃ vinayo idaṃ satthusāsanan ti,
an4.180:8.5: tassa bhikkhave bhikkhuno bhāsitaṃ n' eva abhinanditabbaṃ na paṭikkositabbaṃ,
an4.180:8.6: anabhinanditvā appaṭikkositvā tāni padavyañjanāni sādhukaṃ uggahetvā sutte otāretabbāni vinaye sandassetabbāni:
an4.180:8.7: tāni ce sutte otāriyamānāni vinaye sandassiyamānāni na c' eva sutte otaranti na vinaye sandissanti niṭṭham ettha gantabbaṃ--addhā
an4.180:9.1: Idha pana bhikkhave bhikkhu evaṃ vadeyya:
an4.180:9.2: amukasmiṃ nāma āvāse eko thero bhikkhu . . .
an4.180:9.7: tāni ce sutte otāriyamānāni vinaye sandassiyamānāni sutte c' eva otaranti vinaye ca sandissanti niṭṭhaṃ ettha gantabbaṃ--addhā
an4.180:9.11: Ime kho bhikkhave cattāro mahāpadesā ti. [Tass' uddānaṃ:--
